description:
See which account and profile your calls act for, and how this call signed in.
Use for: checking who you act for before other calls, and whether the account still needs a profile.
Not for: your money (get_wallet).
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: get_account({})
Errors: only the common ones; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.
name: get_account

credential.description: How this call signed in: an API key, or hosted sign-in.

profile.description: The profile this call acts for. Left out when the account has no profile yet; then finish setup at `setupUrl`.

name.description: Left out when the profile has no name yet.

setupUrl.description: Where to make a profile. Left out when the account has one.

title: Get your account
